meaning: A closed content-addressed compiler source capsule embeds exact selected definition, profile, configuration and provider bytes needed to construct and generate reconciled checked artifacts outside the development checkout.
construction: An explicit source manifest pins each logical source ID, repository-relative source path and SHA-256. Materialization verifies those pins and emits a deterministic module. It never refreshes the source pins, searches for alternate sources or executes embedded provider text.
runtime: Runtime access verifies the embedded manifest/content identity and returns immutable byte strings by closed logical ID. It does not read the development filesystem or revive checked snapshots from JSON.
coverage: Include graph composition and exact field definitions, action and Workflow binding/recovery/materialization/outcome definitions, all selected generator definitions, base/language/configuration profiles, Enum provider source and additive minimal-context definition.
authority: Bundling candidate definitions neither admits their meaning nor publishes or releases the package. Distribution qualification remains a later task.
verification: upstream checked construction using capsule only
